[Unit]
Description=Declared development worker
[Service]
Type=simple
User=stand
ExecStart=/opt/stand/pkgs/dev-worker/bin/worker --wait
Restart=no
KillMode=control-group
TimeoutStopSec=5
MemoryDenyWriteExecute=yes
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
PrivateTmp=yes
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

[Unit]
Description=Declared user timer
[Timer]
OnBootSec=1h
OnUnitActiveSec=1h
Unit=stand-development.service
Persistent=false
[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

[Unit]
Description=Declared scheduled user command
[Service]
Type=simple
User=stand
ExecStart=/opt/stand/pkgs/source-example-built/bin/program
Restart=no
KillMode=control-group
TimeoutStopSec=5
MemoryDenyWriteExecute=yes
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
PrivateTmp=yes
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

[Unit]
Description=Declared user schedule
[Timer]
OnBootSec=1s
OnUnitActiveSec=1min
Unit=stand-scheduled-example.service
Persistent=false
[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
